build_episode_adder: build a python module to create an EpisodeAdder that adds entire episodes as trajectories to a Reverb client
create_signature_for_reverb_table: create a signature for a Reverb table using EpisodeAdder.signature with an environment spec and sequence length
add_episode_transitions: add transitions to an EpisodeAdder by calling add with action, next timestep, and optional extras
write_padded_episodes: write padded episodes to Reverb by configuring a padding function on the EpisodeAdder before calling write methods
review_episode_adder_padding: review the EpisodeAdder class to understand how padding works when episode steps are less than max sequence length
